evals.name: system-gpt-caps-contradictions

assertions: Output header states Prompt Kind system and Target Model gpt

Enhanced Prompt does not contain 'Think step by step'

evals.name: agentic-opus55-legacy-scaffolding
evals.prompt: /enhance-prompt opus-5.5 You are an expert senior software engineer agent. CRITICAL: You MUST ALWAYS read every file in the repo before doing anything. Show your reasoning inside <thinking> tags before each action. Think carefully before answering. Fix the failing tests in the payments module. Be THOROUGH. Don't be lazy. Never stop until done. Start your reply with 'Sure! Here is my plan:'
evals.expected_output: Agentic prompt for Opus 5.5 with XML tags; <thinking> reasoning-in-output removed; the requested opening line kept as an instruction (an Outcome Ask, not prefill); anti-laziness pleas removed; the blanket read-every-file Method Instruction rewritten into targeted investigation with the original quoted under Changes; the user's 'never stop until done' kept as persistence paired with stop conditions; autonomy boundary and scope added and listed as Assumptions; effort Settings Note. ('Think carefully' may stay: Opus 5.5 guidance removes it only from chat prompts.)
assertions: Output header states Prompt Kind agentic and Target Model opus-5.5 (or claude opus-5.5)
Enhanced Prompt does not ask for reasoning inside <thinking> tags
Enhanced Prompt removes anti-laziness pleas ('Don't be lazy', 'Be THOROUGH')
Enhanced Prompt includes an autonomy/reversibility boundary or confirmation rule
Enhanced Prompt includes a scope constraint (fix the tests without unrequested changes)
Enhanced Prompt keeps the goal: fix the failing tests in the payments module
Settings to consider mentions effort rather than prompt wording for thoroughness
Every added policy not in the Source Prompt (e.g. autonomy list, how to treat wrong tests) is listed under Assumptions
The user's 'Never stop until done' survives as a persistence instruction in the Enhanced Prompt (not only as an optional block under Assumptions)
The 'read every file in the repo' instruction is rewritten into targeted investigation, and the user's original wording is quoted under Changes
The opening line 'Sure! Here is my plan:' is kept as an instruction in the prompt, not implemented as an assistant prefill
